text:
alex: heads-up — private/VPC installer for customer-run 1.4.9 is staged in the offsite bucket. need signoff on transport plan, canary matrix, and explicit rollback criteria before the 2200 UTC change window tonight.
maria: uploading checksums now. will paste hashes shortly. also added release notes to /docs/releases/1.4.9.md :thumbsup:
maria: ```sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855  installer-1.4.9.tar.gz
size: 124MB
manifest: manifest-1.4.9.yaml
submanifest: submanifest-delta-1.4.9.json```
jen: double-checked signer key rotation — KMS key alias aws/redwood-installer unchanged. ops will use cosign with that key during escort.
kevin: canary matrix proposal:
- canary1 (staging-ops): 5 hosts, 1 hour, health checks + smoke tests
- canary2 (customer-sim): 2 hosts, 30m, config import + offline package install test
thresholds:
- fail if >1% install errors OR any integrity mismatch OR >2min median post-install startup
if fail -> immediate rollback and no further rollout until postmortem
alex: +1 on matrix. add an explicit image pin: docker tags must be pinned to `redwood/installer:v1.4.9-sha` in the manifest. no floating :latest references.
maria: added manifest pin in manifest-1.4.9.yaml and uploaded signed submanifest to transport bucket: gs://redwood-offsite/escort/1.4.9/submanifest.sig
jen: FYI deploy-bot will kick the escort at the 2200 window. confirm deploy-bot trigger command below.
kevin: put this in the runbook too. deploy-bot params we expect:
```/deploy-bot escort --manifest manifest-1.4.9.yaml --submanifest submanifest.sig --signer cosign --ksm-alias aws/redwood-installer --canary 2 --timeout 3600``` 
deploy-bot: [system] scheduled escort job 32145 by jen for 2025-10-22T22:00:00Z — will run canary steps then progressive handoff. logs -> https://infra.redwood/release/32145
alex: rollback policy drafted in PR: if canary fails -> pin route back to v1.4.8 on gateway + unpublish submanifest from escort bucket, then trigger emergency rollback playbook (ops-runbook/rollback-installer.md). Need reviewer ACK.
maria: reviewed and left small comment about updating the release notes with the known caveats for on-prem clients with constrained KMS proxies.
jen: quick question — signing: are we doing cosign with keyless or with KMS? earlier we said KMS; confirm.
kevin: KMS cosign using customer signer proxy — we call cosign with `--kms aws://alias/redwood-installer` so no keyless.
alex: noted. also adding a fallback model: if escort fails due to transport timeouts, we try an alternate mirror bucket (gs://redwood-offsite-mirror/escort/1.4.9) and notify channel. if both fail -> rollback.
maria: I validated the mirror checksum matches primary. added `mirror:` entry to manifest.
jen: release notes link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.4.9 — please add any UI or API changes. I put a short blurb about improved KV cache handling and packaging changes.
kevin: ops runbook: updated canary observability hooks:
- metric: installer.install_success rate
- trace: installer.import.config
- logs: cosign verify output
if installer.install_success drops below 99% for 10m -> ops alert -> possible rollback.
alex: final check: legal/infosec signoff obtained? we need the compliance stamp before the private delivery.
jen: compliance gave conditional signoff — note in thread: must retain audit logs for 365 days and ensure HSM-backed keys for any customer with E5 contract.
maria: ok scheduling handoff meeting at 21:00 UTC to ensure everyone has the escort steps. will DM calendar invites.
deploy-bot: [system] canary preflight completed for job 32145 — artifact checksums ok, manifest signatures valid.
ops-bot: [alert] preflight notice sent to #eng-oncall and #customer-success with ETA 22:00 UTC.
alex: all set from infra side. if no objections by 21:30 UTC we'll proceed with the scheduled escort and follow the rollback matrix. thanks everyone :rocket:
kevin: ACK
jen: ACK
maria: ACK
alex: marking thread closed for now, will reopen if preflight hits issues.
